summary: Updated implementation plan combining the 100% pixel-accurate 2 reference stamp templates (Template 1 Satellite Brebes style & Template 2 Light Street Map + Magnetometer µT style) with the full Interactive Map Location Picker feature (pan, zoom, tap-to-place/drag marker, 'Lokasi Saya' helper, 'Pilih Lokasi / OK' vs 'Batal' transactional state, automatic reverse geocoding + Plus Code, strict protection against GPS overwrite, and Room database persistence including 'location_source').
